The parent EVERLASTING collection establishes a vehicle-battery monitoring and prediction research role. Simulation uses: the EVERLASTING parent collection establishes calibration inputs for predicting electric-vehicle battery behaviour, lifetime and range. Coverage: exact measurement periods remain unstated. Access: public native metadata describes the release and stated formats. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The short description does not specify individual variables, measurements, model settings or test periods. This record describes supporting data; it does not assert that executable Kalman-filter code is present. Related battery-estimation deposits have separate native identities.
